name: 科研配色｜薰紫春庭
description: Low-saturation lavender, dusty rose, cream apricot and sage default chart palette.

shading.front_and_top: Use the exact assigned core color.

rules: The six core HEX values are authoritative and keep their listed order for categorical series.
Use named semantic roles for increase/decrease and threshold states; preserve their labels and signs.
Use the same category assignment in faces, legend swatches and anchor dots.
Use dark text on pastel data marks; small text contrast must be at least 4.5:1.
Use explicit labels or outlines as well as color; do not claim universal color-vision safety.
Hierarchies with more than six leaves use parent-family tints; do not invent unrelated accent hues.
Project-specified palettes may override this default. Keep native metadata synchronized where native replacement is used.
